messages:
maya: Following up on PM-2026 postmortem action items — a few are overdue. Copying list from the doc. Please ack and give ETA by EOD. Items:
1) config rollback automation - owner @juan - due 2024-12-12
2) KV-cache eviction metrics dashboard - owner @priya - due 2024-12-10
3) postmortem writeup addendum - owner @sam - due 2024-12-08

juan: Ack. I'm blocked, taking longer because the rollback script interacts with Dedicated autoscaler. Will have a PR by tomorrow but need a quick review from @sam. ETA: 12/14.

sam: @juan I can review tomorrow morning. Can you paste the failing log snippet? Also note the rollback uses `rb-rollback-v2`.

juan: Sure — failing lines below: 
```
ERROR: autoscaler: scale_down failed: cannot snapshot pool state
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "autoscale/manager.py", line 412, in scale_down
    pool.snapshot()
RuntimeError: snapshot timeout
```
I think timeout is from KV eviction slowing down pool snapshots.

sre-bot: Reminder: Action item 1 assigned to juan is 48h overdue. Link: https://redwood/issues/INC-2026/actions/1

elena: @juan @maya tagging since this is blocking customer SLA. If PR isn't up by 16:00 PST, escalate to infra-ops and I'll reassign.

juan: Understood. PR now opened: https://git/repo/pull/432. Tests are failing on `test_autoscale` — I think it's a race. Prioritizing a fix.

priya: Quick update: dashboard is done, pushed to grafana staging, data looks good. URL: https://grafana/staging/d/abc. Leaving notes in the ticket. Mark as resolved.

lee: Verified the storage metrics on staging for the dashboard. Looks reasonable. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks @priya and @lee. I marked item 2 closed in the postmortem doc.

sam: Reviewing juan's PR now. Found the race: `if len(queue) == 0` check. Pushed a tiny patch to handle concurrent dequeues.

juan: Patch applied, CI green. Deployed to canary. Monitoring.

sre-bot: Deploy to canary succeeded. Monitor link: https://deploys/redwood/432

juan: Canary looks stable after 30m. No regressions. Will schedule full rollout tonight 22:00 UTC.

elena: Good. Once full rollout completes, please update postmortem and close the loop.

maya: Full rollout done? @juan

juan: Completed 22:25 UTC. Updated ticket, included rollback test steps and a small checklist.

maya: All items addressed except item 3 (postmortem addendum). @sam do you have an ETA?

sam: I'll add the addendum today, will push before EOD.

sre-bot: Action item 1 and 2 closed. Action item 3 due today.

sam: Addendum posted and linked in the doc: https://redwood/pm/PM-2026#addendum — Done.

maya: Great. Closing thread. I've updated PM-2026 with statuses and set a monthly recurring check to watch for similar cache eviction incidents. Thanks everyone. :tada:
